plans.idea: Centred product lockup: the phone sits just left of centre and a tight left-aligned stack of logo, then a big 'Glow.', then SHOP SOLSTICE runs beside it, so brand, headline, product and CTA read as one group with even breathing room on both sides.

Headline-first banner that reads left to right: logo, then a large 'Glow.', then the CTA stacked flush-left in the left half, with the phone as the product payoff right of centre on the same baseline grid.
Phone as the central axis: 'Glow.' fills the space on its left, and the logo sits above SHOP SOLSTICE on its right, a balanced three-part split that keeps the original's centred, symmetrical feel.
